history.summary: Launch build: more of the Blender makeover across the maps, flags, weapons and the first-person sleeve. Visuals only; nothing plays differently.
Pre-release: code audit, graphics fixes, a frame governor (Settings > Video > Frame Rate Priority) and a Blender makeover of weapons and map props.
Pre-release: every map gets its own match music, an opening and a closing minute.
Pre-release: the Store and the Exclusive Store, paid in Platinum Stars earned in Matchmaking, ten new characters, the Bot Reset. No real money.
Pre-release: every class worth playing (class levels and mastery, field upgrades, class challenges, role XP).
Pre-release: the Galactic Games champion's rewards (three new aliens, a plague doctor, plasma weapons in Matchmaking).
Pre-release: IT'S NOON SOMEWHERE (Elite 3.3), 60 fps by default, fixes from the full audit.
Pre-release: The Sleigh Drop, Christmas from December 1 to 31.
Pre-release: Funland, Lowell Hill and Moon Base rebuilt.
Pre-release: two new maps, High Strung and Tockbury Square.
